rationale: CI run 42139239429, job 127635056721, at source head 87a8a67d642e308e29be4dd699db4b242c431b98 against base fc8c1dd13f7cde790f5aadb55fdada1f7b60e6c9 measured 959 unresolved calls of 31,085 and 58 typing positions, with zero architecture violations. Set only calls_unresolved from 957 to 959 and typing_positions from 56 to 58. The two added unresolved calls are the finite output-limit argument registration in cli._collector_output_limit (cli/__init__.py:531) and forwarding the explicit per-run limit into the Studio explore scope (cli/__init__.py:324). The two new typing positions are raw TOML boundary annotations at cli.config._collector_timeout (config.py:107) and cli.config._bundler (config.py:119); both validate untyped decoded TOML values before use. Contract changes expose codec-owned DEFAULT_RESPONSE_LIMIT_BYTES and MAX_RESPONSE_LIMIT_BYTES to the CLI, declare those two constants public in ir, and move the two existing, exact Windows-only ctypes attr-defined allowances to their current lines (process.py:465 and :477); the allowed statements are unchanged. This binds the measured contract and baseline changes only.
